component.name: Stellarshot
component.summary: Back up your files with encrypted snapshots

description.p: Stellarshot is a backup application for the COSMIC desktop. It keeps encrypted, deduplicated snapshots of your folders in a restic-compatible repository, so your backups remain readable with the restic and rustic command-line tools even without this app.

Set up several independent backups, each with its own folders and destination. A setup wizard shows exactly how much will be backed up, with excluded folders subtracted. Backups run in the background with progress and Cancel, and passwords can be remembered in the desktop keyring.
Stellarshot is a fork of the cosmic-utils Stellarshot project and is under active development.
